items.headline: Jayden Daniels, Commanders 'keep fighting through adversity,' improve to 2-4-1
items.description: After falling behind 10-0 in the first half, quarterback Jayden Daniels led the Washington Commanders on a rousing rally, cruising to a 27-10 win over the Philadelphia Eagles at Northwest Stadium, an effort in which he threw for 217 yards and a touchdown.

items.headline: Saquon Barkley has assurances he won't be traded, wants to help Eagles 'fix it'
items.description: Speaking after Sunday night's 27-10 loss to the Washington Commanders, Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley told reporters he has received assurances from the front office that he will remain with the club beyond the Nov. 10 trade deadline.
